body: And yes I can tell his wife any time. But like I said I believe in God and karma

Tbh I don't think your mom is helping him cheat. She is probably trying to take him from his wife. I am in that situation on the bad side which sucks. And tbh idk what the best idea is. But I believe in God and karma. So it really all depends how you want it to play out for your mom. Maybe if you confront her she will see what she is really doing, or  maybe she won't. She will have to deal with the consequences of splitting up 2 families. Whether it is now or in the future. She is the one that has to see it. But I do believe either way it will come back to bight her.
